name: viking-longship
description: A Viking longship floating at the waterline (y = 0): a long, open, clinker-built oak hull with sheer rising to the ends, five overlapping strakes and a gunwale per side, keel, keelson, floor boards, crossbeams and rowers' sea chests; tall stem and stern posts, the stem with a carved dragon head or a scroll; a row of oars through oar ports on each side that sweep about their ports; round painted shields along the shield rail; a mast with yard, shrouds, stays and sheets carrying a bellied square sail in red and white stripes or plain red that can be furled; and a steering oar on the right side at the stern.

params.name: length
params.description: Hull length in metres (the Gokstad ship is 23.2 m, Skuldelev 2 about 30 m).

params.name: beam
params.description: Width of the hull at the middle.

params.name: oarsPerSide
params.description: Oars (and oar ports) along each side.

params.name: oarAngle
params.description: Sweep of the oars in degrees: 0 is square to the hull, negative pulls the blades aft.

params.name: sail
params.description: How far the square sail is let down from the yard: 0 = furled, 1 = fully set.

params.name: sailStripes
params.description: Red and white stripes on the sail instead of a plain red-ochre wool sail.

params.name: shields
params.description: Round shields along the shield rail on both sides.

params.name: dragonHead
params.description: A carved dragon head on the stem; without it the stem ends in a curl.
